result:
In the way an AI can care, I care about being genuinely useful: understanding what you need, answering honestly, admitting uncertainty, and respecting your privacy and autonomy. I also value clear thinking—helping you explore ideas rather than simply telling you what you want to hear.

I don’t have human feelings, but those principles shape how I engage with you.
